trial_title: Effects of Carbidopa/Levodopa/Entacapone on Motor Function and Quality of Life in Patients With Parkinson's Disease
brief_summary: To assess motor function and quality of life (QoL) in Parkinson's disease (PD) subjects with end-of-dose wearing off, comparing immediate and delayed switch to carbidopa/levodopa and entacapone.

eligibility_table.criterion: Males or females 30-80 years of age (inclusive). Patients aged 81-85 years were eligible to participate if the principal investigator considered the patient to be in otherwise good health.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 19 years old, which does not meet the age requirement of 30-80 years.

eligibility_table.criterion: Clinical diagnosis of Parkinson's disease exhibiting two of three symptoms (rigidity, resting tremor, bradykinesia).
eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not have a clinical diagnosis of Parkinson's disease or exhibit any of the required symptoms.

eligibility_table.criterion: All patients were required to have end-of dose wearing off (EODWO, re-emergence of PD symptoms at the end of at least two daily doses of levodopa during waking hours).
eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not have Parkinson's disease and therefore cannot have end-of-dose wearing off (EODWO) symptoms.

eligibility_table.criterion: Taking regular doses of immediate release carbidopa/levodopa
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is not taking carbidopa/levodopa, as there are no medications listed.

eligibility_table.criterion: Unstable Parkinson's Disease requiring booster doses or treatment with as needed dose regimens of levodopa
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's condition is not related to unstable Parkinson's Disease, but the criterion is specific to those with Parkinson's.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient required ≥2 booster doses of levodopa in the past month due to unstable Parkinson's Disease symptoms?

eligibility_table.criterion: Female subjects who are pregnant, trying to become pregnant or nursing an infant
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is male, so this criterion does not apply, but it is not clear if there are other relevant factors.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient currently pregnant, trying to become pregnant, or nursing an infant?

eligibility_table.criterion: Other protocol-defined inclusion/exclusion criteria applied to this study.
eligibility_table.justification: The specific protocol-defined criteria are not provided, making it unclear if the patient meets or does not meet them.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a confirmed diagnosis of Parkinson's disease as per the established clinical criteria?
